message.content:
1) **Yes**, the text is legible and grammatically continuous. There are no broken or orphaned words; the text wraps naturally within its container.
2) **It visually breaks the paragraph.** The monospace path `/regions/<slug>` is placed awkwardly between "Path-" and "), a scoped first (", creating a disjointed reading experience and poor vertical alignment within the middle column.
3) **Needs a fix.** While the overall design is clean, the poor handling of the inline code snippet in the middle column makes it look like a layout bug rather than a polished, production-quality component.
